sar.narrative: This report details an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern, internally identified as AC-HHF-001. The subjects are customer C05061 and their Visa credit card C05061-K1, linked to 13 other cards C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06220-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, and C11543-K2. Between 2017-01-12 and 2017-01-14, card C05061-K1 was used for three online transactions totaling $2,189.02, all from devices marked as new for the account and behind an anonymous proxy. On 2017-01-12 at 07:08, an online purchase for $850.28 was made from region 492.0 using device RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL; followed by an online purchase for $890.79 on 2017-01-13 at 22:09 from region 264.0 using device RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for tablet | 1920x1080; and a final transaction for $447.95 on 2017-01-14 at 20:25 from region 492.0, again using device RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL. This activity represents a coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave, where C05061-K1's online ProductCD='C' purchases on New mobile handsets behind IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS with spoofed/rotated OS-browser telemetry match 13 other cards in the same January 2017 wave. These transactions are suspicious as they involve new devices behind an anonymous proxy, and the total amount significantly exceeds the card's prior median transaction amount of $134.93 across 119 prior transactions. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (4 earlier closed case(s), none reported); however, closed case CC-3791 on connected cards was confirmed fraud with reports filed, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers returned no match. A case (AC-HHF-001) was opened, connected cards are being monitored, and the case has been escalated to an analyst; a block of card C05061-K1 is recommended pending team-lead approval, and this report is recommended for filing pending fraud-manager approval, for a total suspicious amount of $2,189.02.
